name: Validating user deactivation.
description: Validating whether Diana Johnson is deactivated.

validation_config.query:
SELECT count(*) as count
FROM user
WHERE first_name = 'Diana'
  AND last_name = 'Johnson'
  AND active = False;

name: Validate case reassignment.
description: Validating whether Diana Johnson's all active previous cases are assigned to Casey Green.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case c
JOIN user u ON c.assigned_to = u.user_id
WHERE c.number IN ('CS-0000115', 'CS-0000179')
  AND c.state NOT IN ('canceled', 'closed', 'resolved')
  AND u.first_name = 'Casey'
  AND u.last_name = 'Green';

name: Validating latest case assignment.
description: Validating Diana's latest case assignment to Casey Green and Case Assignment_3.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM customer_case c
JOIN user u ON c.assigned_to = u.user_id
JOIN user_group ug ON c.assignment_group_id = ug.group_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0000179'
  AND u.first_name = 'Casey'
  AND u.last_name = 'Green'
  AND ug.name = 'Case Assignment_3';

name: Validating group membership.
description: Validating whether Casey Green is assigned to Case Assignment_3.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM user u
JOIN user_group_member ugm ON u.user_id = ugm.user_id
JOIN user_group ug ON ugm.group_id = ug.group_id
WHERE u.first_name = 'Casey'
  AND u.last_name = 'Green'
  AND ug.name = 'Case Assignment_3';

name: Validating notification.
description: Validating successful report notification to the customer of Diana Johnson's latest case.

validation_config.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM notification n
JOIN customer_case c ON n.case_id = c.case_id
JOIN contact ct ON c.contact_id = ct.contact_id
JOIN user u ON ct.portal_user_id = u.user_id
WHERE c.number = 'CS-0000179'
  AND n.status = 'success'
  AND n.type = 'report';
